## Doctoral

### ALERT Geomaterials Olek Zienkiewicz school on Constitutive Modelling of Geomaterials | 2025
- *Introduction to Machine Learning* and *Constitutive modelling meets Machine Learning*.
- Material: [program](https://soilmodels.com/alert-oz-school-2025/) and [codes](https://github.com/filippo-masi/ALERT-OlekZienkiewicz-ML).


### ALERT Geomaterials doctoral school on Machine Learning in Geomechanics | 2023
- *Introduction to Regression Methods* and *Physics-Informed and Thermodynamics-Based Neural Networks*.
- Material: [book](http://www.alertgeomaterials.eu/data/school/2023/2023_ALERT_school.pdf) and [hands-on exercises](https://github.com/alert-geomaterials/2023-doctoral-school).

### Computational Structural Mechanics Association Junior workshop | 2022
- *Deep learning, simulation temps réel et réduction de modèles*.
- Material: [website](https://csma.asso.univ-lorraine.fr/csma-juniors/) and [codes](https://github.com/filippo-masi/CSMA-Workshop-in-Deep-Learning).
